mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dataset_source_contribution (dataset_key, source_dataset_key, enriched, by_info) SELECT #{datasetKey}, e.source_dataset_key, e.enriched, hstore(array_agg(c.type::text), array_agg(c.cnt::text)) FROM ( SELECT source_dataset_key, count(DISTINCT verbatim_source_key) AS enriched FROM verbatim_source_secondary WHERE dataset_key = #{datasetKey} AND source_dataset_key IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ) e JOIN ( SELECT source_dataset_key, type, count(*) AS cnt FROM verbatim_source_secondary WHERE dataset_key = #{datasetKey} AND source_dataset_key IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1, 2 ) c ON c.source_dataset_key = e.source_dataset_key JOIN dataset src ON src.key = e.source_dataset_key GROUP BY e.source_dataset_key, e.enriched
mapper.select: SELECT g.key, sum(g.value::int) AS count FROM dataset_source_contribution c JOIN dataset d ON d.key = c.source_dataset_key CROSS JOIN LATERAL each(c.by_info) AS g WHERE c.dataset_key = #{datasetKey} AND d.gbif_publisher_key = #{publisherKey} GROUP BY g.key
